# StarWatchr

> StarWatchr is a web application for planning stargazing and astrophotography. It combines astronomy forecasts, live object altitude calculations, a deep-sky catalogue, an interactive sky atlas, and a solar-system explorer.

## Core tools

- [Stargazing forecast](https://starwatchr.com/): Plan an observing session using cloud cover, twilight, Moon, seeing, and transparency data.
- [Deep-sky forecast](https://starwatchr.com/dso-forecast): Find Messier and Caldwell objects and open their individual observing pages.
- [Sky atlas](https://starwatchr.com/sky-atlas): Explore the sky with constellation and star-hop tools.
- [Solar system](https://starwatchr.com/solar-system): Explore planets, moons, dwarf planets, asteroids, and comets.

## Content guidance

StarWatchr's object pages combine stable catalogue facts with interactive, location-dependent visibility data. Use the page's named object, type, constellation, magnitude, distance, and observing season as the stable reference. Treat current altitude and visibility as time- and location-specific calculations.

## Data provenance

- Deep-sky catalogue measurements are linked to the SIMBAD astronomical database operated by CDS, Strasbourg.
- Solar-system facts link to NASA Science or the NASA/JPL Small-Body Database. Rounded derived comparisons are labelled as such.
